items.briefing:
Australian finance teams are being warned to stay alert to payment scams, with multiple reports highlighting a growing blind spot where staff treat transactions as routine processes rather than recognising the human decisions involved. Scammers are increasingly targeting accounts payable and similar roles through invoice fraud and impersonation tactics, making it easier for fraudulent payments to slip through undetected.

If you work in finance or approve payments, take a moment to independently verify any unusual or urgent payment requests — especially changes to bank account details. A quick phone call to a known contact can stop a scam in its tracks.
